Priya: For internal blurb: short bullets + link to runbook. Example: "Stability fixes to kernel fallback and batching timeouts; no customer-facing API changes."
Maya: Love that. I'll use that copy. Also include owners: Maya (PM), Jon (Eng), Arthur (Ops), Priya (Docs).
Arthur: Runbook snippet for immediate checks:
```bash
# quick health check after canary
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"input":"status"}' https://api.redwood.ai/health | jq '{status:.status, latency_ms:.latency_ms}'
# check errors
kubectl -n inference get pods --selector=app=runtime -o json | jq '.items[] | {name:.metadata.name, restarts:.status.containerStatuses[].restartCount}'
```
Arthur: Rollback steps (condensed):
1) pin dispatcher back: `kapply dispatcher-v0.41.9.yaml`
2) scale down canary: `rb canary scale model-redwood-l3 0`
3) promote fallback pool and restart runtime pods: `rb promote model-redwood-l2 && kubectl rollout restart deployment/runtime`
I'll paste exact commands in runbook.
